components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single committing action in a view (Done, confirm).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 40px; padding: 0 24px; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-action, #0b57d0); color: #fff; font: 500 14px Roboto, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-action-hover, #0842a0); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0b57d0; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Share Pill
components.description: Signature Share control in the editor header.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-share"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><rect x="3" y="11" width="18" height="11" rx="2"/><path d="M7 11V7a5 5 0 0 1 10 0v4"/></svg>Share</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-share { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 40px; padding: 0 20px; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-share, #c2e7ff); color: var(--color-share-ink, #001d35); font: 500 14px Roboto, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms; } .ds-btn-share:hover { background: var(--color-share-hover, #b3d7ef); } .ds-btn-share:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0b57d0; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Button
components.css: .ds-btn-text { padding: 8px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; background: transparent; color: var(--color-action, #0b57d0); font: 500 14px Roboto, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms; } .ds-btn-text:hover { background: var(--color-hover, #e9eef6); } .ds-btn-text:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0b57d0; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Formatting Toolbar
components.description: Full-width pill holding tool buttons with hairline group dividers.
components.css: .ds-toolbar { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 2px; height: 40px; padding: 0 8px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-pill, #edf2fa); } .ds-tool { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 28px; height: 28px; border: none; border-radius: 4px; background: transparent; color: var(--color-ink-2, #444746); transition: background-color 150ms; } .ds-tool svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; } .ds-tool:hover { background: var(--color-pill-hover, #dfe5ee); } .ds-tool:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0b57d0; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-tool-active, .ds-tool-active:hover { background: var(--color-active, #d3e3fd); color: #041e49; } .ds-tool-divider { width: 1px; height: 20px; margin: 0 4px; background: var(--color-line, #c7c7c7); }

components.name: Outlined Field
components.description: Email entry in the Share dialog.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" type="email" placeholder="Add people by email">
components.css: .ds-input { height: 48px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid #747775; border-radius: 4px; background: #fff; color: var(--color-ink, #1f1f1f); font: 400 16px Roboto, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--color-ink-2, #444746); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #0b57d0; outline: 2px solid #0b57d0; outline-offset: -2px; }

components.name: Search Pill
components.description: Documents home search; turns white and lifts on focus.
components.html: <label class="ds-search"><svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#444746" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="8"/><path d="m21 21-4.3-4.3"/></svg><input type="search" placeholder="Search"></label>
components.css: .ds-search { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 48px; max-width: 720px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-pill, #edf2fa); } .ds-search:focus-within { background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.2); } .ds-search input { flex: 1; height: 100%; border: none; background: transparent; font: 400 16px Roboto, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #1f1f1f; outline: none; }

components.name: Role Chip
components.description: Shows the signed-in user's role on a shared document.
components.html: Shared with you · Editor Shared with you · Viewer
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-block; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 9999px; font: 500 12px Roboto, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-chip-editor { background: #d3e3fd; color: #041e49; } .ds-chip-viewer { background: #e3e3e3; color: #444746; }

components.name: Document Row
components.description: Fully round hover row in the documents list.
components.html: Q3 Planning Notes5 minutes ago
components.css: .ds-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; padding: 12px; border-radius: 9999px; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 150ms; } .ds-row:hover { background: var(--color-hover, #e9eef6); } .ds-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0b57d0; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-row-title { flex: 1; font: 500 14px Roboto, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #1f1f1f; } .ds-row-meta { font: 400 14px Roboto, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #444746; }

components.name: Save Status
components.description: Signature save-state line beside the document title.
components.html: Saved
components.css: .ds-save { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font: 400 13px Roboto, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--color-ink-3, #5f6368); } .ds-save-error { padding: 0 4px; border: none; border-radius: 4px; background: transparent; font: 500 13px Roboto, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--color-danger, #b3261e); } .ds-save-error:hover { background: var(--color-danger-bg, #fce8e6); } .ds-save-error:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0b57d0; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
Ajaia Docs speaks the Docs grammar near-faithfully so the tool disappears: a cool off-white chrome, one rounded toolbar pill, a white Letter-size page on the canvas, a pale-blue Share pill, and one saturated action blue. Nothing is invented for decoration. Every bit of novelty the system allows goes to legibility of state: whether the document is saved, who owns it, and what role you hold.

The system is dense and quiet. Chrome text sits at 14px in Roboto; the document itself is Arial at 11pt, exactly like a word-processor page. Surfaces are flat tints of blue-grey; depth appears only where something floats (page, menus, dialogs). Shapes split cleanly: interactive controls and pills are fully round, the page and fields are nearly square.
keyCharacteristics: Cool blue-grey chrome (#f9fbfd) around a white, hairline-edged page.
One action blue for commits; a pale Share pill as the single signature control.
Two type worlds: Roboto for the app, Arial 11pt for the document.
Fully rounded controls and hover rows; near-square page, fields and cards.
Save status and role are always visible text, never inferred.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Commit Blue is the only saturated color in chrome. Fills are reserved for the single committing action in a view; everything else is a tint or text.

rules.name: The Share Pill Rule
rules.body: Share Sky belongs to Share. Do not reuse it for other buttons, badges or banners.

rules.name: The Two Worlds Rule
rules.body: Arial never appears in chrome, and Roboto never appears on the page.

rules.name: The Regular Heading Rule
rules.body: Headings in both worlds are weight 400 except 16px section titles (500). Hierarchy comes from size, not bold.

rules.name: The Float-Only Shadow Rule
rules.body: Only the page and floating layers (menus, dialogs, focused search) cast shadows. Bars, rows, buttons and cards stay flat.

dos: Do keep a single Commit Blue filled button per view; secondary actions are text buttons.
Do render document content in Arial at 11pt (14.667px) with regular-weight headings.
Do make every control, chip and hover row fully round; keep the page and fields near-square.
Do show save state and the user's role as visible text at all times.
Do use Lucide stroke icons (16-20px chrome, 18px toolbar at 2.25 stroke).
Do generate avatar colors from the fixed seven-color set keyed by email.
donts: Don't use Share Sky anywhere but the Share control.
Don't add shadows to bars, rows, cards or buttons; only floating layers lift.
Don't introduce new saturated hues in chrome; semantic colors are for state only.
Don't use Google branding or the Google logo; the Ajaia folded-page mark is the identity.
Don't bold headings for hierarchy; scale size instead.
